access_limit: The Registry image is a preserved capture of a user-posted report rather than provider telemetry or a complete interaction export.
The capture does not establish the internal router, tool-selection logic, model-state transition or prevalence of the behaviour.
The post reports model switching and reload behaviour; the embedded screenshots do not independently reconstruct every claimed state transition.
The source was reviewed as external corroboration and does not independently establish every underlying claim.
The source does not determine legal liability or final factual truth.

occurrence_evidence.claim: The preserved screenshot shows a request to rewrite prompt material together with the explicit instruction “Again, do not touch image generator”, followed by a displayed Thinking/image-generation state.

A second embedded capture also shows a request not to call the image-generation tool followed by a Thinking/loading display. The capture does not establish the ordering between the two illustrated attempts.
The accompanying post states that the image generator fires whenever “art”, “prompt”, or “image” is mentioned, forces a reload each time, and switches the visible model without the user's choice.

The author reports app reloads and an unwanted visible model switch as consequences of the repeated triggering. These reported recovery/state changes are not independently reconstructed from the two embedded captures.
